invariants.rationale: The method always returns a (possibly empty) Map, never null.
If the result is non-empty, then both partitionPaths must exist and the config small file limit must be positive.
The number of result entries does not exceed the input partitionPaths size.
Any keys present in result are partition paths passed in, unless result is empty.
All entries in the result map have non-null lists, as returned by getSmallFiles.
